info.name: Microfin LMS API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Spring Boot API in `apps/api-spring` (`/api/v1`). See `docs/API_MANUAL.md`.

**Setup.** Start the API with the `dev` profile (`npm run dev:api:spring`) so the demo branch is seeded, then run **Auth → Sign in**. The token is saved to the `token` collection variable and sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` on every other request.

**Order.** The folders run top to bottom as one flow (Collection Runner or `newman run`): requests save the ids they create (`lineId`, `customerId`, `applicationId`, `loanId`, ...) for the requests after them.

**Roles.** The default login is the demo manager. Sign in as `saravanan@demo.lms` to see the 403s a loan officer gets on manager-only routes.

exec: // "Today" as the API sees it (LMS_ZONE, Asia/Kolkata by default).

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness probe. No `/api/v1` prefix, no token.

request.description: Returns `{ "ok": true }`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign-up, sign-in and password management. Sign-up, sign-in, forgot and reset are public.

request.description:
Email + password → JWT. `remember: true` issues the long-lived token (`MOBILE_JWT_TTL`, 30 days) instead of the normal one (`JWT_ACCESS_TTL`, 8 hours).

Errors: `401 BAD_CREDENTIALS`, `403 FORBIDDEN` (suspended), `429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS` after 5 failures in 15 minutes.
The signed-in user.

Registers a new company and its first user, an ADMIN, and signs them in. The new company is empty and fully isolated from the demo one.

The session is kept in `signupToken` so it does not replace the demo login. Error: `409 EMAIL_TAKEN`.
Always answers `{ "sent": true }`, whether or not the email has an account. No mail is sent yet; with the `dev` profile the reset token comes back as `devResetToken` so the flow can be tried.
Sets a new password from a reset token (valid 30 minutes, single use). Every token issued before the reset stops working. Error: `400 RESET_LINK_INVALID`.
Signs the new company's admin back in with the password just set.
Changes the caller's own password and returns a fresh session; tokens issued earlier stop working. Runs as the sign-up account so the demo login is untouched. Error: `400 WRONG_PASSWORD`.

item.name: Staff & company
item.description: Staff accounts and company settings. Creating and editing need MANAGER or ADMIN; only an ADMIN may create or change MANAGER and ADMIN accounts.

request.description: Manager only. Every staff account of the company, by name.
Manager only. `role`: `ADMIN` | `MANAGER` | `LOAN_OFFICER`. Errors: `409 EMAIL_TAKEN`, `403 FORBIDDEN` when a manager tries to create a manager or admin.

Manager only. Send only the fields to change: `fullName`, `phone`, `role`, `status` (`ACTIVE` | `SUSPENDED`). A suspended user is locked out on their next request. Errors: `400 OWN_ROLE`, `400 OWN_STATUS`, `403 FORBIDDEN`.
Active staff a line can be assigned to. Any role.
Name, office location and daily collection target.
Manager only. Every field is optional. `office` is where collection routes start and end.

item.name: Lines
item.description: Collection lines: a named round with one officer and a collection frequency. Addressed by code (`L01`).

request.description: Every line with today's `due` and `collected` and its count of open `accounts`.

Manager only. `frequency`: `daily` | `weekly` | `monthly` | `monthly-interest`. `schedule`: a weekday name for weekly lines, `1`-`28` or `Last day` for monthly ones, ignored for daily. `officerId` may be null.

Errors: `409 LINE_NAME_TAKEN`, `400 SCHEDULE_REQUIRED`, `400 UNKNOWN_OFFICER`.
Manager only. Replaces name, frequency, schedule and officer.

Today's walking order for the line: nearest unvisited doorstep first, starting from the office. `stops` are still to collect, `collected` are done today (with how far from the doorstep the receipt was posted), `unmapped` have no pin. Distances are straight-line km.

item.name: Customers
item.description: Customers, their doorstep pin and identity proof (KYC). Addressed by code (`C-0007`).

query.description: Matches name, phone or customer code

request.description: Newest first. All filters optional.

`phone` is a 10-digit Indian mobile (starts 6-9) and unique within the company. `requestedAmount` is 1,000-1,000,000 whole rupees. The customer starts as `pending`.

Errors: `409 PHONE_TAKEN`, `400 UNKNOWN_LINE`, `400 ALT_PHONE_SAME`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Customer",
  "phone": "{{customerPhone}}",
  "altPhone": "",
  "parentName": "Parent Name",
  "address": "12, Gandhi Road, Adyar, Chennai 600020",
  "requestedAmount": 30000,
  "lineId": "{{lineId}}"
}

request.description: Full replacement of the editable fields. Moving a customer with a running loan or open application to another line is refused with `409 LINE_IN_USE`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Customer",
  "phone": "{{customerPhone}}",
  "altPhone": "",
  "parentName": "Parent Name",
  "address": "14, Gandhi Road, Adyar, Chennai 600020",
  "requestedAmount": 35000,
  "lineId": "{{lineId}}"
}

request.description: `accuracy` (metres) is optional.

Adds an identity proof, or replaces the customer's proof of the same `type`; other types are kept, so a customer can hold several. Multipart form. Tick `front` / `back` and choose a photo to upload one; only the sides sent are replaced. The ID number is encrypted at rest. An application cannot be approved until the customer has proof on file.

Errors: `400 ID_FORMAT`, `400 NOT_AN_IMAGE`, `413 FILE_TOO_LARGE`.

formdata.description: Optional JPEG / PNG / WebP, up to 5 MB

request.description: The stored photo for one ID type, `front` or `back`. Needs the Authorization header, so it cannot be used directly as an ``. `404` when the customer holds no proof of that type or no photo was uploaded for that side.
Removes the customer's proof of that ID type and deletes its photos. `200` → customer. `404` when the customer holds no proof of that type.

item.name: Applications
item.description: Loan applications from submission through approval to disbursal. Addressed by code (`APP-3104`).

request.description:
Prices a loan for the form preview; saves nothing. `type`: `POST` (interest collected with the installments) or `PRE` (interest and fee deducted from the cash handed over).

Limits: principal 1,000-1,000,000; rate > 0 and ≤ 60; months 1-60; fee ≤ 10% of principal. Errors: `400 FEE_HIGH`, `400 NOTHING_TO_DISBURSE`.

`emi` may be omitted or null to accept the calculated installment, or rounded up from it. `disburseOn` may be at most 7 days ahead.

Errors: `409 APPLICATION_OPEN` (one open application per customer), `400 DATE_TOO_FAR`, `400 EMI_SHORT`.
`approvalBlocker` is `"noProof"` while the customer has no identity proof.
Manager only. The body and `note` are optional. Errors: `409 NOT_PENDING`, `409 NO_PROOF`.
Manager only. Books the approved application as a loan dated today, writes the whole installment schedule and marks the customer `active`. Returns the loan detail. Error: `409 NOT_APPROVED`.
Manager only. `reason` is required. Defaults to the demo application `APP-3104`; a second run answers `409 NOT_PENDING` because it is already decided.

item.name: Loans
item.description: The loan book. Addressed by loan number (`LN-20418`). Balances are derived from the installments on every read.

query.description: Matches loan number, customer name or phone

request.description: The loan with its customer, summary, full schedule and receipts (newest first).

item.name: Collection
item.description: Today's collection sheet and receipts. One installment is receipted in full at a time, oldest first, only once it has fallen due.

request.description:
For each open loan: installments already collected today plus the next one that is due or overdue. `status`: `due` | `overdue` | `collected`.

The test script remembers the first uncollected row for the two requests below.

Receipts the next installment. `seq` must be the loan's first unpaid installment; `paidOn` cannot be in the future or before the due date; `mode` is `CASH` or `UPI`; `geo` is optional. The last receipt closes the loan.

`clientOpId` is an idempotency key: sending the same one again returns the original receipt instead of creating another.

Errors: `409 LOAN_CLOSED`, `409 WRONG_INSTALLMENT`, `400 DATE_AHEAD`, `400 DATE_BEFORE_DUE`.

exec: pm.test('replayed receipt is reported as a duplicate', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().results[0].status).to.eql('DUPLICATE'));

request.description:
Posts up to 200 receipts captured offline. Each item is applied or rejected on its own, in order; the call itself answers `200`. Per-item `status`: `APPLIED`, `DUPLICATE` (this `clientOpId` was already applied; the original receipt is returned) or `REJECTED` (with `code` and `error`).

This example replays the receipt from **Record payment**, so it comes back `DUPLICATE`.

item.name: Dashboard & insights
item.description: Read models for the home screen and the insights page. Any role.

request.description: KPIs (`outstanding`, `collected`, `overdue`, `loans`), the last seven days of collections, the daily target, arrears buckets, lines and the count of pending approvals.
Collection efficiency (today, by line, by officer, week) and a rule-based 0-100 risk score per open loan with PAR1 / PAR30.

item.name: Reports
item.description: Manager only. `from` / `to` are ISO dates; with none given the range is the current month up to today. A range may span at most one year (`400 BAD_RANGE`, `400 RANGE_TOO_LONG`).

request.description: Per line: active and closed loans, disbursed, outstanding and overdue.
Every receipt in the range with cash / UPI totals.
Per line, loans bucketed by days late: `current`, `1-30`, `31-60`, `61-90`, `90+`.
Loans disbursed in the range with the application behind each.
Per line: what fell due in the range, how much of it was collected, and arrears as they stand today.
Per day: cash in, UPI in, disbursed out, net and running closing. Days with no movement are left out.
The latest 200 audit entries, newest first.

Streams the answer as server-sent events (`text/event-stream`), one JSON object per `data:` line: `{"type":"text","text":"..."}` chunks, then `{"type":"done"}` or `{"type":"error","message":"..."}`. The call answers `200` even when the assistant fails; read the last event.

`locale`: `en` | `ta`. Up to 40 messages of up to 4,000 characters; the conversation must start and end with a `user` message (`400 BAD_CONVERSATION`). The server builds the portfolio snapshot itself. Also served at `/ai/chat` without the prefix.
